terminal.invalidSummary: Terminal artifact summary must be a string when present.
terminal.invalidInterpreter: Terminal script interpreter must be bash or powershell.
terminal.scriptOverwritesSession: The launch script must not overwrite the session file or its completion marker.
terminal.assistantFailed: The child assistant's final turn failed or was aborted.
terminal.notRunning: The terminal run has already finished.
terminal.invalidDelay: The shell readiness delay must be a finite non-negative number.
terminal.sessionMismatch: Terminal session identity does not match the existing session file.
terminal.transcriptChanged: The session transcript was replaced or truncated during the terminal run.
terminal.invalidReference: Terminal execution requires a terminal session reference with non-empty run/session IDs and absolute session/script paths.
